title: Orangegroves for instance. Need artificial irrigation. Bleibtreustrasse.
html_source: This is a reference to the planter’s company “Agendath Netaim” whose advertisement Bloom read in Chapter 4. Their address was “Bleibtreustrasse 34, Berlin, W, 15”.
